AppSettings.label: Rumble
AppSettings.hint: The motors in your controller, where the console's games drive them; a change reaches a game already running.

AppSettings.label: Swap A and B in menus
AppSettings.hint: A and B trade what they do in the library, the menus and every sheet, and so do X and Y, for a controller with a Nintendo layout. Games keep their own bindings.

AppSettings.label: Guide chords
AppSettings.hint: Guide held with Up saves, with Down loads, with R1 takes a screenshot; Auto keeps them off in Steam's Game Mode, whose own chords they would clash with.

AppSettings.label: Controller type
AppSettings.hint: Which buttons the help bar draws. Automatic follows the controller last pressed; only the pictures change.

AppSettings.label: Only the first controller
AppSettings.hint: Only the first controller connected steers the menus, and games hear player 1's controller alone, as when a wireless pad registers twice.

AppSettings.label: Controller notices
AppSettings.hint: A notice at the top of the screen when a controller is connected or disconnected.

AppSettings.label: On-screen keyboard
AppSettings.hint: What types into a text row and the search. Automatic uses Steam's keyboard under Steam and EmuSen's otherwise.

AppSettings.label: Left stick as the D-pad
AppSettings.hint: In games whose console has no stick, the left stick also presses the D-pad.

AppSettings.label: Stick deadzone
AppSettings.hint: How far a stick must travel before it counts as a direction. Raise it if your stick drifts.

AppSettings.label: Mirror player 1 to player 2
AppSettings.hint: Player 1's controller also plays as player 2, for games that read the second controller, as Super Mario All-Stars' classic games do. Leave off for two players.

AppSettings.label: Keyboard
AppSettings.hint: The player the keyboard plays as, beside that player's controller.

AppSettings.label: The first controller pressed is player 1
AppSettings.hint: In a game, the first controller a button is pressed on is player 1 and the others follow in the order they are used.

AppSettings.label: External controller first
AppSettings.hint: On a handheld, a controller connected to it is player 1 ahead of the built-in controls.

AppSettings.label: Text size
AppSettings.hint: Every word on the big screen, and the desktop's, through the interface's type scale.

AppSettings.label: Background art on Home
AppSettings.hint: The focused game's art behind Home, dimmed and blurred.

AppSettings.label: Reduced motion
AppSettings.hint: No movement, shorter fades. System follows the desktop's own setting.

AppSettings.label: Start-up splash
AppSettings.hint: Moonrise while big picture starts: a moon, and a planet and a bell for each console. Any button skips it.

AppSettings.label: Light or dark
AppSettings.hint: Dark is the big screen's default; Light, or the desktop's own choice.

AppSettings.label: Play videos
AppSettings.hint: A game's clip plays in its picture once the focus rests on it, where it has one.

AppSettings.label: Status bar
AppSettings.hint: The desktop's bar along the bottom of the window.

AppSettings.label: Messages
AppSettings.hint: The game's name, Paused, State saved and errors at the bottom left.

AppSettings.label: Frame rate
AppSettings.hint: The frames-per-second readout while a game runs.

AppSettings.label: Volume
AppSettings.hint: The game's volume.

AppSettings.label: Navigation sounds
AppSettings.hint: The sounds for moving, choosing and going back, on a stream of their own beside the game's; a theme without one plays EmuSen's.

AppSettings.label: Sound volume
AppSettings.hint: How loud the navigation sounds are, beside the game's own volume.

AppSettings.label: Help prompts
AppSettings.hint: Where the viewer shows its buttons: at the top, at the bottom, or not at all.

AppSettings.label: Display media types
AppSettings.hint: The help names the item shown: video, box cover, screenshot and the rest.

AppSettings.label: Keep videos running when viewing images
AppSettings.hint: The video plays on while the pictures are browsed; off, it stops, and starts again on return.

AppSettings.label: Stretch videos to screen resolution
AppSettings.hint: The video fills the screen beside the help, its shape not kept.

AppSettings.label: Render blur for videos
AppSettings.hint: A slight horizontal blur over the video, as a well-used CRT shows it.

AppSettings.label: Play audio for media viewer videos
AppSettings.hint: The viewer's videos play with their sound.

AppSettings.label: Output
AppSettings.hint: Where the game's sound and the interface's sounds play.

AppSettings.label: Hidden games
AppSettings.hint: Games hidden from the library. Their files are never touched; listing them lets you unhide them on their page.

AppSettings.label: Use ScreenScraper
AppSettings.hint: Art and facts from ScreenScraper, for the games the Scraper is asked to fetch.

AppSettings.label: Region
AppSettings.hint: Whose box art and names come first.

AppSettings.label: Other regions after
AppSettings.hint: Else world, USA, Europe, Japan, then any.

AppSettings.label: Language
AppSettings.hint: The language of descriptions and names.

AppSettings.label: ScreenScraper's names
AppSettings.hint: Show the names ScreenScraper gives rather than the files'.

AppSettings.label: Refresh what is kept
AppSettings.hint: Fetch again what a game already has.

AppSettings.label: OpenEmu's sources
AppSettings.hint: OpenVGDB and libretro's thumbnails when ScreenScraper has nothing.

AppSettings.label: Covers
AppSettings.hint: Fetch covers.

AppSettings.label: Screenshots
AppSettings.hint: Fetch screenshots.

AppSettings.label: Marquees
AppSettings.hint: Fetch marquees.

AppSettings.label: Mix images
AppSettings.hint: Fetch mix images.

AppSettings.label: Title screens
AppSettings.hint: Fetch title screens.

AppSettings.label: Back covers
AppSettings.hint: Fetch back covers.

AppSettings.label: Physical media
AppSettings.hint: Fetch physical media.

AppSettings.label: Fan art
AppSettings.hint: Fetch fan art.

AppSettings.label: Manuals
AppSettings.hint: Fetch manuals.

AppSettings.label: Videos
AppSettings.hint: Fetch videos.

AppSettings.label: 3D boxes
AppSettings.hint: Fetch 3d boxes.

AppSettings.label: Group your collections
AppSettings.hint: If unthemed puts a collection the theme has no folder for inside Collections.

AppSettings.label: Favourites on top
AppSettings.hint: Favourite games sorted above the rest.

AppSettings.label: Favourites on top in your collections
AppSettings.hint: The same, in your own collections.

AppSettings.label: Stars in your collections
AppSettings.hint: A star beside a favourite in your own collections.

AppSettings.label: Default sort order
AppSettings.hint: A list's own choice in its options lasts until EmuSen closes.

AppSettings.label: Folders on top
AppSettings.hint: A console's folders above its games, as ES-DE sorts them.

AppSettings.label: Random entry button
AppSettings.hint: Either thumbstick pressed in jumps to a random game, or console.

AppSettings.label: Big picture
AppSettings.hint: Start full screen with larger text, for a handheld or a television; it takes effect at the next start.

AppSettings.label: Pause in the background
AppSettings.hint: A game paused because another window came to the front starts again when this one comes back.

AppSettings.label: Continue where you left off
AppSettings.hint: Every game is saved when it is closed; this is what happens the next time it starts.

AppSettings.label: Play time counted up to
AppSettings.hint: A launch longer than this adds nothing to the game's play time, so a game left running overnight does not count the night.

GraphicsConfig.label: Smooth motion
GraphicsConfig.hint: One frame per refresh when the display's rate is within 1% of the console's, the sound resampled by the difference.

GraphicsConfig.Consoles.label: Picture shape
GraphicsConfig.Consoles.hint: The screen each console was made for, or each of the frame's pixels square.

GraphicsConfig.Consoles.label: Crop overscan
GraphicsConfig.Consoles.hint: What is hidden at the picture's edges on a console that had a television: the whole picture, the part a television showed, or a crop of your own.
